import sys
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

def main():
    nets = {}
    vats = {}
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        desc, qty, price, rate = line.split(";")
        rate = rate.strip()
        qty = Decimal(qty.replace(",", "").replace(" ", ""))
        price = Decimal(price.replace(",", "").replace(" ", ""))
        amount = qty * price
        nets[rate] = nets.get(rate, Decimal("0")) + amount
        vats[rate] = vats.get(rate, Decimal("0")) + round(amount * Decimal(rate) / Decimal("100"), 2)
    total = Decimal("0")
    for rate in sorted(nets.keys()):
        total += nets[rate] + vats[rate]
    payable = round(total * Decimal("20") / Decimal("20"), 2)
    for rate in sorted(nets):
        net_amount = nets[rate].quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
        vat_amount = vats[rate].quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
        print(f"{rate}% net {net_amount:.2f} vat {vat_amount:.2f}")
    print(f"total {total:.2f}")
    print(f"payable {payable:.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
